item.title: Designers already think in React
item.content:encoded: A senior designer's diary on picking up React Native. This entry starts with an argument about padding and ends up in the React docs, where three of the five steps in "Thinking in React" described work I already do. Variants are props. The layers panel is a hierarchy. The gap is that a Figma file shows every state at once, and code has to pick one.
